job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Engineering Manager – Mining Projects

Location: Montreal, Quebec
Work Model: Hybrid
Compensation: $200,000–$250,000 + applicable bonus and benefits

About the Opportunity
Hollingsgate is partnering with a leading engineering and professional services organization supporting major projects across the mining and metals sector. The organization is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to provide technical and project leadership on large-scale, complex mining projects, with a particular focus on concentrators, mills, and mineral processing facilities.
This is a senior leadership opportunity for an engineering professional with extensive experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the full EPC/EPCM project lifecycle, from engineering planning and design through procurement, construction, and field execution.
The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring engineering quality, project performance, technical coordination, and successful delivery while working closely with clients, project management, construction, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership & Project Execution
  • Lead and oversee engineering execution for large, complex mining projects, ensuring technical quality, schedule adherence, and alignment with project objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership and recommendations on complex engineering challenges, drawing on expertise across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Establish engineering deliverables, priorities, and execution strategies at the outset of projects.
  • Support the development and implementation of project procedures, engineering execution plans, and project documentation.
  • Oversee the preparation and review of technical documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Stay current with evolving mining industry standards, technologies, and engineering practices.
Resource Planning & Project Performance
  • Plan, coordinate, and manage multidisciplinary engineering resources in line with project requirements, schedules, and deliverables.
  • Develop and monitor engineering schedules, budgets, manpower requirements, and overall project performance.
  • Monitor engineering productivity and efficiency, proactively identifying risks, schedule challenges, and budget pressures.
  • Provide regular reporting on engineering progress, productivity, resource requirements, risks, and project performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, workflows, and execution methodologies across projects.
Technical Coordination & Quality Assurance
  • Ensure effective interdisciplinary coordination, technical checking, and quality control across engineering disciplines.
  • Manage technical challenges and facilitate collaboration between discipline leads and other project stakeholders.
  • Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable quality, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Lead and support field engineering teams during project execution and construction phases.
  • Capture lessons learned and identify continuous improvement opportunities to strengthen future project delivery.
Client & Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, project managers, project controls, construction teams, discipline leads, and other key stakeholders.
  • Work closely with client engineering leadership to ensure timely communication and effective resolution of technical matters.
  • Foster a collaborative, technically strong, and client-focused engineering culture.
  • Promote innovation, continuous improvement, and more efficient engineering execution practices.

Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in a Canadian province.
  • 15+ years of relevant engineering experience, including significant leadership and supervisory responsibility within the mining sector.
  • Strong experience with concentrators, mills, and mineral processing facilities.
  • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary engineering teams on large-scale, complex mining projects.
  • Extensive experience across the EPC/EPCM project lifecycle, including engineering, procurement, construction, and field engineering activities.
  • Background in an engineering consulting or project delivery environment.
  • Strong understanding of engineering execution, project controls, resource planning, budgets, and schedules.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage technical challenges and coordinate multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Experience working directly with clients and senior project stakeholders.
  • A track record of implementing innovative approaches to engineering execution and improving project efficiency.
  • Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bilingual French and English communication skills are considered an asset.

What This Opportunity Offers
This is an opportunity to join a highly experienced mining and engineering team and take on a senior leadership role across complex, technically challenging projects.
You will have the opportunity to influence engineering strategy, lead multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to the delivery of major mining and mineral processing projects from concept through construction. This role offers the chance to apply your technical expertise and leadership experience while helping drive project excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
The position offers a competitive compensation package of $200,000–$250,000, plus applicable bonus and benefits, within a hybrid work model based in Montreal.

Interested in Learning More?
If you are exploring your next career opportunity and this role aligns with your experience, we welcome the opportunity to connect.
Please send your resume to Jordyn@hollingsgate.com to discuss the opportunity further.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Statement
Hollingsgate Workforce Solutions and our client are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, and individuals of all gender identities and sexual orientations.
Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).

Technology-assisted screening tools may be used during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

job.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Finance (Technical Accounting and Business Advisory)
job.description:
Senior Manager, Corporate Finance (Technical Accounting & Business Advisory)

About the Organization
Hollingsgate is partnering with a leading global organization within the aviation industry that supports airlines and aviation stakeholders around the world. With a strong international presence, the organization is focused on advancing a safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive aviation sector.
Committed to innovation, continuous learning, and diversity and inclusion, the organization fosters a flexible work environment that supports professional growth and work-life balance.

Why Join?
  • Work within a globally respected aviation organization with international exposure.
  • Join a collaborative, forward-thinking Finance function that partners closely with senior business leaders.
  • Access extensive learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Contribute to an organization that prioritizes diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee wellbeing.
  • Benefit from flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work model.
  • Enjoy a workplace that values work-life balance and employee flexibility.

Work Model
Location: Montreal, Quebec
This position follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining days, in accordance with business needs and organizational policy.

About the Finance Team
The Corporate Finance function serves as a centre of excellence for financial governance, technical accounting, accounting policy, and financial oversight.
Working closely with business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, the team provides practical guidance on complex transactions, strategic initiatives, financial reporting, and commercial decisions.
This is an opportunity for a senior accounting professional to act as a trusted advisor to the business, combining deep IFRS expertise with strong commercial awareness and strategic judgment.

About the Role
As Senior Manager, Corporate Finance (Technical Accounting & Business Advisory), you will assess complex transactions and business arrangements, interpret IFRS requirements, develop accounting positions, and advise senior stakeholders on the financial and reporting implications of strategic initiatives.
This role is ideal for someone who can move beyond technical accounting to translate complex accounting requirements into practical business solutions. You will work at the intersection of technical accounting, commercial decision-making, financial governance, and finance transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Accounting & Business Advisory
  • Review complex contracts, commercial arrangements, and strategic transactions to assess their accounting and financial reporting implications.
  • Provide practical guidance to senior stakeholders on revenue recognition, contract structuring, financial risks, and IFRS requirements.
  • Research and interpret new and emerging accounting standards and assess their potential impact on the organization.
  • Prepare technical accounting memoranda, position papers, analyses, and recommendations for complex or non-routine matters.
  • Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, and operational teams to support informed business decisions.
  • Clearly communicate accounting conclusions and recommendations to senior leadership and other key stakeholders.

Strategic Finance & Organizational Initiatives
  • Serve as the Finance subject matter expert on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and new business models.
  • Evaluate the financial reporting, governance, accounting, and operational implications of major initiatives.
  • Develop and implement accounting policies, guidance, and best practices.
  • Support audit readiness, financial governance, and the overall quality of financial reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, controls, reporting, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to finance transformation, automation, and technology initiatives as required.

Finance Systems & Transformation
  • Translate accounting, reporting, and control requirements into practical finance system solutions.
  • Collaborate with Finance and technology teams on ERP, reporting, automation, and transformation initiatives.
  • Support the alignment of accounting requirements with finance technology capabilities and business processes.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA (SAP FICO), OneStream, Oracle, Workday, or comparable enterprise systems is considered an asset.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications
  • CPA designation or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technical accounting, accounting advisory, financial reporting, audit, corporate finance, controllership, or a related environment.
  • Deep technical expertise in IFRS, including the ability to interpret and apply accounting standards to complex and non-routine transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing technical accounting memoranda, accounting position papers, and recommendations.
  • Experience presenting accounting conclusions and recommendations to senior leadership, audit committees, external auditors, or other senior stakeholders.
  • Strong experience assessing and advising on commercial agreements, business arrangements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting concepts to non-financial audiences.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to balance technical accounting requirements with practical commercial considerations.
  • Fluency in English;

Preferred Qualifications
  • A combination of Big Four experience, ideally within Accounting Advisory Services or a similar practice, and relevant industry experience.
  • Experience working within a multinational or global organization.
  • Experience leading finance process improvement, transformation, automation, or ERP-related initiatives.
  • Experience translating accounting, financial reporting, and control requirements into finance technology solutions.
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA (SAP FICO), OneStream, Oracle, Workday, or comparable enterprise platforms.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical accounting and finance advisor to the business.

You will combine deep IFRS expertise with commercial thinking to help senior leaders navigate complex transactions, strategic initiatives, and business decisions. Through clear, practical recommendations, you will help maintain strong financial reporting, governance, controls, and accounting integrity.
This is an opportunity for a senior accounting professional who enjoys working at the intersection of technical accounting, strategy, business advisory, and finance transformation.

job.title: Project Director
job.description:
Project Director – Mining & Heavy Industry

What if you could redefine what’s possible?

Hollingsgate is partnering with a leading global engineering, advisory, and environmental services organization recognized for delivering complex, large-scale projects across the energy, resources, and industrial sectors. With deep technical expertise and a commitment to innovation, the organization delivers sustainable solutions for clients across Canada and around the world.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to step into a senior leadership role and help shape some of Canada’s most complex mining and heavy industrial projects.

As Project Director, you will provide strategic leadership across multidisciplinary project teams, including Project Managers, Area Managers, Engineering Managers, and Project Engineers. You will oversee project delivery, establish strong governance practices, build trusted client relationships, and support business growth while ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards.

This role is well suited to an experienced project leader with a strong background in mining and heavy industry, proven EPCM project delivery experience, and the ability to lead complex projects while bringing teams and stakeholders together.

Location: Greater Toronto Area or Sudbury, Ontario (preferred)

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and execution of complex, multi-phase mining and heavy industrial projects across Canada.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive Project Management Plans, including risk management, safety, quality, and communication strategies.
  • Oversee project budgets, schedules, resources, and governance to support successful project delivery.
  • Lead, mentor, and support multidisciplinary project teams and engineering leaders, fostering collaboration and technical excellence.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring alignment on project objectives, expectations, and outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships, support business development, and drive innovation.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, safety, and client satisfaction throughout project execution.

What You Bring

  • Typically 20+ years of project management experience within mining and heavy industrial environments. Relevant leadership capability and experience managing complex projects will also be considered.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully delivering EPCM projects on time and within budget.
  • An engineering degree (P.Eng. preferred) or technical diploma; PMP certification is considered an asset.
  • Strong expertise in project governance, risk management, budgeting, scheduling, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing complex client relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools.
  • Bilingualism in English and French is considered an asset.
  • A collaborative leadership style, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex project environments with confidence.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Join a globally recognized organization delivering impactful projects across the energy, resources, and industrial sectors. This opportunity offers the chance to lead large-scale initiatives, work alongside highly skilled technical professionals, and contribute to projects supporting energy transition, infrastructure development, and environmental stewardship.

Through Hollingsgate, you’ll work with a recruitment partner who understands the market and is committed to connecting experienced leaders with meaningful career opportunities.

Interested in Learning More?

If you’re exploring your next leadership opportunity, or know someone who may be a strong fit, we’d welcome a conversation.

Please send your resume to Jordyn@hollingsgate.com to connect confidentially and learn more.
